missing-header:content-security-policy.rationale: CSP is a defence-in-depth protection mechanism; absence is commonly filed under protection-mechanism failure. It does not by itself indicate XSS.

missing-header:x-frame-options.rationale: Framing restrictions relate to rendered UI layers and frames (clickjacking).

missing-header:x-content-type-options.rationale: MIME-sniffing protection is a defence-in-depth mechanism.

missing-header:referrer-policy.rationale: No well-fitting CWE chosen; referrer leakage depends on application content. Left unmapped on purpose.

missing-header:permissions-policy.rationale: Browser-feature restriction is a defence-in-depth mechanism.

missing-header:strict-transport-security.rationale: Relates to cleartext transmission. The finding stays inconclusive when the target was tested over plain HTTP.

open-port.rationale: Informational exposure observation, not a weakness.
